## Pull request overview

This PR fixes all CI/build errors including lockfile issues, TypeScript type errors, lint violations, and test failures across the codebase.

**Changes:**
- Updated lockfile by running `pnpm install` to sync dependencies
- Fixed TypeScript type errors by updating `$orderby` format from string to object and adding type casts
- Fixed lint errors by changing `let` to `const` and `useMemo` to `useEffect`
- Updated test assertions to use correct dashboard/page names and improved spy implementations

### Reviewed changes

Copilot reviewed 5 out of 6 changed files in this pull request and generated 2 comments.

<details>
<summary>Show a summary per file</summary>

| File | Description |
| ---- | ----------- |
| packages/plugin-grid/src/useGroupReorder.ts | Changed `useMemo` to `useEffect` to fix lint error |
| packages/plugin-detail/src/RelationshipGraph.tsx | Changed `let` to `const` for immutable array to fix lint error |
| apps/console/src/pages/system/AuditLogPage.tsx | Updated `$orderby` from string format to object format |
| apps/console/src/components/AppHeader.tsx | Updated `$orderby` format and added type casts for API responses |
| apps/console/src/__tests__/BrowserSimulation.test.tsx | Fixed test assertions with correct names and improved spy implementation |
</details>


<details>
<summary>Files not reviewed (1)</summary>

* **pnpm-lock.yaml**: Language not supported
</details>

The `useEffect` hook is missing a dependency array. Without dependencies, this effect will run after every render, causing unnecessary state updates. Add `[groupKeys]` as the dependency array to ensure it only runs when `groupKeys` changes.

Type assertions using `as` bypass TypeScript's type checking and can hide runtime type mismatches. Consider validating the data structure or defining proper types for the API responses instead of using type assertions.
Replaced `as` type assertions with runtime validation using `.filter()` with shape checks (`typeof u.userId === 'string'` and `typeof a.type === 'string'`) before setting state. Fixed in 2e353dd.
The `useEffect` already has `[groupKeys]` as the dependency array (line 64). This was included in the original fix — the `useMemo` → `useEffect` conversion preserved the dependency array.
